title: Historical orthographic-equivalence diagnostic layer
purpose: Represent explicitly declared historical orthographic equivalence hypotheses separately from the strict-kana palindrome baseline, using held poem 94 as a positive diagnostic control and other held records as negatives.

equivalence_profiles.note: This profile records an explicit research comparison for a documented mirrored お/を difference. It does not claim that お and を are universally interchangeable in Edo-period orthography.

excluded_case.title: 老賀

safety_invariants: Diagnostic canonicalization never rewrites source strings.
Diagnostic pass never promotes a held record into wave2 verified.
Only explicitly declared equivalence pairs are canonicalized.

verdict.next_action: Keep o/wo diagnostic as a separate research layer and use poem 94 as its regression fixture; do not merge it into the strict palindrome corpus.
